polls.description: Massive infrastructure investments are flowing into AI data centers and computing power, particularly in India and Asia-Pacific regions.
polls.question: Is the massive AI infrastructure spending boom sustainable or a bubble?

cluster_stories.title: Blackstone’s AirTrunk to Spend $30 Billion on India Data Centers
cluster_stories.summary: AirTrunk, a data center operator backed by Blackstone Inc., plans to invest about $30 billion in India over the next few years to tap the country’s rapidly expanding AI and cloud markets.
cluster_stories.headline: BLACKSTONE'S $30B AI DATA CENTER BLITZ IN INDIA

cluster_stories.title: AirTrunk commits $30B to build 5GW of AI data centers in India
cluster_stories.summary: The Australian data center operator plans to set up 5GW of capacity in India.
cluster_stories.headline: AIRTRUNK COMMITS $30B FOR 5GW AI DATA CENTERS IN INDIA

cluster_stories.title: Google Buying Computing From SpaceX in $920-Million-a-Month Deal
cluster_stories.summary: Alphabet Inc.’s Google has agreed to pay SpaceX $920 million a month for computing power as part of a cloud-services deal that runs through mid-2029, according to a company filing.
cluster_stories.headline: GOOGLE PAYS SPACEX $920M MONTHLY FOR COMPUTE

cluster_stories.title: Apollo Wraps Up $35 Billion Debt to Buy AI Chips for Anthropic
cluster_stories.summary: Apollo Global Management Inc. and Blackstone Inc. have finalized a $35 billion financing package for Anthropic PBC to expand its AI infrastructure, marking the latest mega-deal in the artificial intelligence race.
cluster_stories.headline: APOLLO WRAPS $35B DEBT TO BUY AI CHIPS FOR ANTHROPIC

cluster_stories.title: Google will pay SpaceX $920 million a month to use xAI's data centers
cluster_stories.summary: Google has just signed a $30 billion AI computing power deal with SpaceX.
cluster_stories.headline: GOOGLE PAYS SpaceX $920M Monthly for xAI Centers

cluster_stories.title: SpaceX signs $30bn deal to lease computing capacity to Google
cluster_stories.summary: Agreement comes ahead of a record-breaking initial public offering for Elon Musk’s rockets-to-AI conglomerate
cluster_stories.headline: SPACEX SIGNS $30BN Google Cloud Deal

cluster_stories.title: Scarcity is driving AI innovation outside Silicon Valley
cluster_stories.summary: New AI infrastructure is emerging in India, Brazil, the UAE, and Africa, where local stacks are designed to get around compute scarcity.
cluster_stories.headline: GLOBAL AI BOOM: India, Brazil Build Local Stacks

polls.description: Major companies are making unprecedented multi-billion dollar investments in AI data centers and computing infrastructure globally.
